info.description: The 2-minute demo story: Harbor City's sterile possession, a goal against the run of play, Northvale's press, a turnover goal that levels it 1-1, then a free kick and a late penalty. Tactically: Harbor City's false nine and inverted wingers, Harbor dropping deep once ahead, and Northvale's switch to a back three with two strikers at 52'.

calls.text: And we're under way!
calls.textFi: Ottelu on käynnissä!

calls.text: What a ball from Lucas Ferreira! 45 metres, and right on target.
calls.textFi: Lucas Ferreira lyö upean pallon: 45 metriä ja suoraan perille!

calls.text: What a ball from Aino Lehto! 42 metres, and right on target.
calls.textFi: Aino Lehto lyö upean pallon: 42 metriä ja suoraan perille!

calls.text: Arlo Quinn pulls the trigger, and it's charged down!
calls.textFi: Arlo Quinn laukoo, mutta laukaus blokataan!

calls.text: It's in! Ravi Sharma scores for Harbor City! Harbor City 1-0 Northvale!
calls.textFi: Se meni sisään! Ravi Sharma iskee, Harbor City! Harbor City 1-0 Northvale!

calls.text: That one was clocked at 111 km/h!
calls.textFi: Laukauksen nopeus oli 111 km/h!

calls.text: That's the third shot of the match for Arlo Quinn.
calls.textFi: Arlo Quinn laukoo jo 3. kerran tässä ottelussa.

calls.text: Half time: Harbor City 1-0 Northvale.
calls.textFi: Puoliaika: Harbor City 1-0 Northvale.

calls.text: The second half is under way!
calls.textFi: Toinen puoliaika alkaa!

calls.text: Oh, so close from Ravi Sharma!
calls.textFi: Läheltä piti, Ravi Sharma!

calls.text: What a ball from Felix Moreau! 48 metres, and right on target.

calls.text: 113 km/h from Arlo Quinn! The hardest shot of the match so far!
calls.textFi: 113 km/h, Arlo Quinn! Ottelun kovin laukaus tähän mennessä!

calls.text: Hugo Laine has won the ball high up the pitch 3 times already. Relentless.
calls.textFi: Hugo Laine on riistänyt pallon korkealla jo 3 kertaa. Hellittämätöntä!

calls.text: Change for Northvale: Elias Varga comes on for Yusuf Demir.
calls.textFi: Vaihto, Northvale: Elias Varga sisään, Yusuf Demir ulos.

calls.text: Brilliant stop to keep out Arlo Quinn!
